extension.summary: Movies and series for Lucent, with AIOStreams and Trakt
Films en series voor Lucent, met AIOStreams en Trakt
extension.description: Browse with TMDB, play through your own AIOStreams address and keep your progress on Trakt. Works without Seren.
Bladeren met TMDB, afspelen via je eigen AIOStreams-adres en je voortgang bijhouden op Trakt. Werkt zonder Seren.
extension.news: 0.13.0: Keys never live in the code. Testers get a private tester code: enter it once in the setup assistant (step Keys) and TMDB, Trakt and Simkl work. A key file (keys.json) from a USB stick or network folder works too, or your own free TMDB key. Without a key, Home rows stay empty instead of opening a window. Trakt login no longer needs a Client Secret. 0.12.0: Setup assistant on first start (account, keys, sources, order, Dolby Vision). Family profiles: "Who is watching?" - everybody has their own account, progress and lists; the Kodi library follows the first profile. 0.11.0: New lists: For you, Calendar and Cast. When a link breaks during playback, Lucent Video continues with the next source at the same point. The next episode's sources are found before the current one ends. Series keep the same release group and quality. Dolby Vision on this device: skip sources this device cannot play. Make an error report: a log without addresses, keys or passwords. 0.10.0: Public Trakt lists (trending, popular, search), MDBList search and your Floppy lists. 0.9.0: Streaming services in your country, newest first. 0.8.0: Easynews and TorBox as sources next to AIOStreams. 0.7.0 and earlier: first versions of Lucent Video - films and series from TMDB, playback through your own AIOStreams address, Trakt and SIMKL, resume and next episode, Lucent-style windows. Not yet tested with real accounts: feedback welcome.
